name: Eye For Death (Combat)
body:
You are able to visualize your victim’s imminent death, reducing the amount of time needed to study them before making a death attack.

Prerequisite(s): Perception 9 ranks, death attack class feature

Benefit: You need only study your victims for 2 rounds before being able to make a death attack against them. If you do not launch the attack within 4 rounds of completing the study, 2 new rounds of study are required. If you choose to study your victim for 3 rounds instead of 2, you may increase the DC of the saving throw to resist the death attack by 1.

Normal: You must study your victim for 3 rounds and make the attack within 3 rounds of completing the study.
